title: Visa TAP failure: request without a TAP tag
summary: A request reaches the verifier without a Signature-Input tagged agent-browser-auth or agent-payer-auth. Under TAP it was not signed by a trusted agent, and the merchant decides whether to block it.

steps.label: GET with no signature, or tag web-bot-auth
steps.detail: The request has no TAP tag. A Web Bot Auth signature with tag web-bot-auth is not a TAP signature either.

steps.label: Look for a TAP tag
steps.detail: No signature carries agent-browser-auth or agent-payer-auth.

failures.outcome: Not signed by a trusted agent

steps.label: Apply bot policy
steps.detail: The merchant may block the request or use other means, such as other bot signals, to decide.

steps.label: 403 or challenge
steps.detail: A blocked request gets the merchant's usual bot response; TAP defines no error code.
